dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: #Oh, it's you! The {M#young lad}{F#young lass} with the bright future ahead of {M#him}{F#her}. What's up? Journey got you tired enough for a soak in the hot spring?

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Well, I haven't learned how to use phlogiston yet, but my back's no longer killing me as much as before. So at least it seems like the healing effect here is better than over at the People of the Springs.

dialogues.speaker: Chikya
dialogues.text: Though I'm still a long, long way away from achieving my real goal, not having such a bad back thanks to this hot spring surely counts for about, say... ten percent!
